decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler. It uses Elemental creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and build a board presence. The inclusion of Leyline Binding helps to lock down opposing threats, while the sideboard companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides additional support. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and support the deck's game plan of out-valuing and outlasting opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the opponent's graveyard with cards through mill effects like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab, allowing for powerful cards like Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to be cast for cheap or massive effects. This disruption strategy is supported by control elements such as Fatal Push, Drown in the Loch, and Spell Pierce, ensuring that the opponent's game plan is disrupted while the mill strategy progresses. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with graveyard disruption and mill effects, ultimately winning through deck depletion.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid, and Colossus Hammer to create a powerful threat that can end the game in just a few swings. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to tutor for combo pieces, along with protection from cards like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and deadly assault. With the inclusion of Urza's Saga and Inkmoth Nexus to provide additional threats, this deck aims to win through a fast and efficient combo strategy.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting opponents with spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. It also utilizes card advantage through spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The deck aims to apply pressure early on, utilizing a mix of cheap spells and creatures to quickly close out games before opponents can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Unholy Heat and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional removal and card selection to maintain tempo and pressure on opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly and efficiently as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Mesmeric Orb, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. The deck utilizes Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity for massive mill potential, with Visions of Beyond providing card draw. Crypt Incursion offers a potential life gain option, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter can be a game-winning finisher against opponents with large libraries. The deck aims to control the game and win through milling the opponent's deck.

This deck revolves around playing aggressively and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes cheap spells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to counter key spells, while also using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure. The deck also has card selection and card advantage tools like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. With removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt, it aims to control the board and maintain tempo. The deck has a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible by utilizing low-cost, efficient burn spells and creatures with haste. By consistently attacking the opponent's life total and keeping them on the defensive, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can establish their own strategy. The deck focuses on maintaining pressure and forcing the opponent to react, making it difficult for them to stabilize and gain control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The strategy also includes using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to generate value and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the deck runs cards like Blood Moon to disrupt enemy mana bases and limit their options, allowing the aggressive creatures to close out the game efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the cycling mechanic to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. This combo can overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures and potentially win the game in one explosive turn. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Force of Negation to protect the combo and control the opponent's spells. The balance between cycling creatures, casting Living End, and disrupting the opponent is crucial for the deck's success in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize mill cards and combo pieces to win the game by depleting the opponent's deck quickly. By using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to mill cards from the opponent's library, combined with Archive Trap and Visions of Beyond to gain advantage, the deck aims to control the game and win through milling. Additionally, cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push provide removal and disruption, while Jace, the Perfected Mind serves as a win condition by milling the opponent out.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively cast cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cheat in powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury for a quick and explosive start. The deck also includes cards like Dead / Gone and Brazen Borrower for tempo plays and disruption. The manabase consists of lands that can produce all three colors needed for the spells in the deck, while also including utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its fast and continuous cascade triggers.

The main focus of this deck is to lock down the opponent's resources while accumulating card advantage through enchantments and controlling the game tempo. By utilizing cards like Enchantress's Presence and Sanctum Weaver, the deck can quickly generate mana and draw cards, allowing the player to establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Destiny Spinner helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while win conditions like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Jeskai Ascendancy provide multiple ways to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan while quickly deploying threats to close out the game. It focuses on using efficient counterspells and removal spells to protect its threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. By combining disruption, card advantage, and a fast clock, this UR Aggro deck aims to pressure opponents into making mistakes and capitalize on them for a swift victory.

This deck aims to use creatures with modular abilities to quickly assemble game-winning combinations. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, alongside creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, this deck can search for and assemble powerful synergies. The creatures also provide additional utility through abilities such as sacrificing for value or generating tokens. With a toolbox of creatures to choose from and ways to tutor them up, this deck can adapt to various situations and opponents, ultimately leading to a combo-based victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also leverages Prismari Command and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding provide additional utility, while Wrenn and Six provide recurring value. The deck aims to be versatile, with options for removal, card draw, and a strong late-game presence with high-impact creatures. The main strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and playing efficient threats with low mana costs to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes artifact creatures and spells to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy, while also using tools like Stoneforge Mystic to search for equipment and Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield using a combination of creatures, artifacts, and equipment to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.
